newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.

text.p: * Tyco International Ltd has offered to acquire American Standard Cos Inc for $50 a share in stock and cash, or about $4 billion plus assumption of debt, according to the Wall Street Journal. Tyco closed at 54-5/8 on the NYSE Friday while American Standard closed at 40-1/4.

* General Motors Corp shares were up 1/4 at 61-3/8 in London following comments by Chief Executive Officer John Smith that the automaker wants to get top dollar for its Hughes subsidiary. GM closed at 61-1/8.

* Raytheon Co appears to be leading Northrop Grumman Corp in the battle to acquire the defense assets of GM's Hughes Electronics Corp for about $9.5 billion, the Wall Street Journal said. Raytheon closed at 47-1/4, Northrop closed at 77-3/4 and Hughes closed at 63-1/8.

* Team Rental Group Inc is expected to announce today that it is buying Ford Motor Co's Budget Rent A Car Co for more than $350 million in cash and stock, the New York Times reported. Team Rental closed at 23-1/4 while Ford ended at 33-3/8.
